    CONVERSATIONS - ISRAEL MEANS BUSINESS™

    WE ARE

    A business platform showcasing Israeli technology, innovation, entrepreneurial accomplishments. 

     

    The Israel Conference™ is an exclusive gathering to meet and network with the charismatic leaders who are creating the business and technology of tomorrow, forging new markets, new companies, and new solutions.
     
    A meaningful nexus for executives to expand business worldwide and exchange ideas about technology, design, and innovation coming from Israel.
     
    We are focused on business creation, job creation, and great ventures between Israel-facing companies.
